'''Sneeve''' was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sneevel/Legends|Sneevel]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It was located in the [[Kastolar sector/Legends|Kastolar sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

==History==
Sneeve was discovered by [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] explorers circa [[14,000 BBY]].<ref name="AA" /> The planet later joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="HNN52" /><ref name="HNN55" />

During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], the planet was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by [[Jollin Resbin]].<ref name="HNN55" /> It allowed [[Refugee Relief Movement/Legends|Refugee Relief Movement]] settlement in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="HNN52" /> When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] broke out, the planet was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space.<ref name="TEA" />

Later, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] tried to prevent the Sneevels from traveling off-system, but the Sneevels felt a greater need to do so because of their prohibition. The Empire appointed a governor to rule Sneeve, but this measure proved to be ineffective, as many Sneevels answered the oppression by joining the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="AA" />

Sneevel was the homeworld of [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] pilot [[Boles Roor/Legends|Boles Roor]].<ref name="Databank">{{DB|character|bolesroor|Roor, Boles}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'' and ''[[Alien Anthology]]'' place Sneeve in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]], while later sources such as [[Star Wars Insider 65|''Star Wars Insider'' 65]] and the website [[HoloNet News (original website)|''HoloNet News'']] locate it in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].
